author.name: Dan Belliveau
author.short: Former senior equities and options trader turned product builder
author.bio: Dan Belliveau spent almost 20 years in the securities industry working in equities and options trading, active-trader product development, and trading-platform design. He formerly held Series 3, 4, 7, 9, 10, 55, and 63 registrations. As a senior trader, he reviewed large equity and options orders, led a large team of active trader support representatives, and helped define requirements for active trading platforms. He is also a licensed Florida real estate sales associate and now builds software and financial tools.

categories.name: Sell & Ship
categories.intro: Tools for people who sell: what you keep after marketplace and ticket fees, the most you can pay for inventory, what a package will really cost to ship, and when to mark down stock that is not moving.

faqs.q: Which seller fees do these calculators include?
faqs.a: The marketplace calculator applies published seller fees for eBay, Poshmark, Vinted, Whatnot, Mercari, Fashionphile, and The RealReal, and the ticket calculator covers StubHub, Ticketmaster Resale, and SeatGeek. Fees change, so every rate can be overridden.

faqs.q: Do the calculators connect to my seller accounts?
faqs.a: No. Everything runs in your browser from the numbers you type. Nothing is uploaded or linked to a marketplace account.

categories.name: Home & DIY
categories.intro: Buy the right amount of material, decide whether to buy, rent, or hire, know when an appliance repair stops making sense, compare heating systems and solar payback, and plan a move or storage.

faqs.q: How accurate are the material estimates?
faqs.a: They use standard geometric takeoffs plus a waste allowance you control. Check product coverage on the label and round up to whole boxes, bags, or gallons.

faqs.q: Where do the energy prices come from?
faqs.a: Defaults come from U.S. Energy Information Administration averages and are shown on each page. Replace them with the rates on your own bills for the most accurate result.

faqs.q: Can these replace a doctor's assessment?
faqs.a: No. They use published screening formulas and cannot account for individual health conditions. Talk to a clinician about your results.

collections.name: Should I…?
collections.title: Should I…? Decision calculators
collections.short: Calculators that answer the real question
collections.intro: Most calculators give you a number. These give you an answer. Each one compares the options side by side, finds the break-even point, and tells you which choice comes out ahead with your numbers and how sensitive that answer is.

faqs.q: How do the decision calculators reach an answer?
faqs.a: Each one totals the full cost or value of every option over time, including the costs people usually leave out, and shows where the options cross. You can change every assumption and the answer updates instantly.

faqs.q: Do they recommend specific products or companies?
faqs.a: No. They compare options using your numbers and never recommend a particular brand, issuer, or provider.
